description: Search Israeli public tenders in Tendy's catalog by free text and filters. Tender data is Hebrew; `query` matches best in Hebrew, in the user's own words. By default only open procurement tenders are returned (published, submission deadline still ahead), the same default as the Tendy website search; `status` and `record_kind` widen it. When the topic is one of the list_categories categories, `category` finds it more precisely than `query`. For an overview of a category, a publishing body, a region, or government or municipal tenders, browse_collection answers in one call. To find a tender by its number or by the body that published it, use `tender_number` or `publisher`. Returns up to 10 tenders per page with deadline, category, city, region and a link to the tender page. Each row has knowledge.completeness: partial or listing_only means Tendy could not read all of that tender's documents; the tender is still a valid result and is not ranked lower. filters_applied.sort_applied is the order actually used.

category.description: Category slug or Hebrew name from list_categories. When the topic is a category, this matches it more precisely than free text; a parent category includes its subcategories.

closes_by.description: Only tenders whose submission deadline is on or before the end of this day, Israel time (YYYY-MM-DD), for 'closing this week' questions. Combine with sort=deadline. Tenders with no known deadline are left out.

publisher.description: The publishing body's Hebrew name, as written on the tender. An unknown name returns close matches.

query.description: Hebrew free text, as the user wrote it.

record_kind.description: procurement_tender (default): tenders only. all: also award notices, cancellations and other publication types.

region.description: One of the listed Israeli districts; ארצי means nationwide.

sort.description: relevance or deadline (soonest first). Free-text search orders by relevance; filters_applied.sort_applied is the order used.

status.description: open: deadline still ahead (default). active: published, including tenders whose deadline passed but are not yet archived. archived: closed and archived. all: everything public, including tenders with no known deadline.

supplier_size.description: Tender size band from Tendy's supplier-fit signal. Tenders Tendy could not size are still included; their supplier_fit is null.

tender_number.description: The tender number as the publisher writes it, for example 12/2026. Slash, dash and space are treated alike.

name: search_tenders

knowledge.description: not_extracted and pending mean unknown to Tendy, not absent from the tender

title: Search tenders
